title: Inside and outside covers
notes: First route: K-1 P1, then P3 to compare coarse and fine triangle covers; grades 2-3 and 4-5 P1-2, then one fine comparison in P3-4. On return, K-1 can choose a limited refinement (P2), alter a boundary (P4), or vary area with the same coarse markings (P5-6). Grades 2-3 can build counterexamples to exact-area claims (P5-6). Grades 4-5 can optimize the refinement budget (P5) and justify monotonicity or compare an exact area (P6-7). Four small squares retain one big-square area unit.
